facts.text: Task: migrate domain mindmatterbh.com from Squarespace to Cloudflare Pages
facts.source_quote: migrate the domain mindmatterbh.com from the old Squarespace site to an already-deployed Cloudflare Pages site

facts.text: Current site: Squarespace, live at mindmatterbh.com
facts.source_quote: Old site: Squarespace, still live at mindmatterbh.com

facts.text: New site: Cloudflare Pages project 'mindmatter-bh', live at https://mindmatter-bh.pages.dev (direct wrangler uploads)
facts.source_quote: New site: Cloudflare Pages project "mindmatter-bh", live at https://mindmatter-bh.pages.dev (direct wrangler uploads, not git-connected)

facts.text: The same Cloudflare account also hosts a personal site; do not touch it
facts.source_quote: CRITICAL: the same Cloudflare account also hosts my personal site (project [name redacted] / [redacted]). Do not touch that project or its DNS.

facts.text: Registrar is likely Squarespace Domains (site was built there), possibly Google Domains legacy, or possibly another registrar
facts.source_quote: Registrar is unconfirmed - likely Squarespace Domains (site was built there), possibly Google Domains legacy or another registrar

facts.text: Step 1: Identify registrar and current DNS host; list current DNS records as rollback snapshot
facts.source_quote: Identify registrar + current DNS host for mindmatterbh.com; list current DNS records so we have a written rollback snapshot before changing anything

facts.text: Constraint: if DNS stays at Squarespace, confirm whether it supports CNAME flattening/ALIAS for apex
facts.source_quote: if the DNS stays at Squarespace, confirm whether its DNS supports what the apex needs (CNAME flattening/ALIAS)

facts.text: Alternative path: move DNS hosting to Cloudflare (add as free zone, import records, switch nameservers) while keeping registration at current registrar
facts.source_quote: walk me through moving just DNS hosting to Cloudflare (add site as a free zone, import records, switch nameservers) while keeping registration where it is

facts.text: DNS-move weakens instant rollback property; requires written rollback procedure
facts.source_quote: note that this weakens the "instant rollback" property - tell me the actual rollback procedure and time for whichever path we take

facts.text: Preference: DNS-record cutover that can be reverted in minutes; avoid destructive steps
facts.source_quote: Prefer a DNS-record cutover I can revert in minutes; avoid destructive steps (do not cancel the Squarespace subscription, do not delete the Squarespace site, do not transfer the domain registration itself right now)

facts.text: Step 2: Decide cleanest path for pointing apex + www at Cloudflare Pages
facts.source_quote: Decide the cleanest path for pointing apex + www at the Pages project

facts.text: Step 3: Lower TTLs first if current host allows
facts.source_quote: Lower TTLs first if the current host allows it

facts.text: Step 4: Add custom domains (mindmatterbh.com and www.mindmatterbh.com) in Cloudflare Pages > mindmatter-bh, then make prescribed DNS changes
facts.source_quote: In Cloudflare Pages > mindmatter-bh > Custom domains: add mindmatterbh.com and www.mindmatterbh.com, then make the DNS changes it prescribes

facts.text: Step 5: Verify apex + www resolve to new site over HTTPS; cert issued; http→https and www/apex canonicalization work; extensionless paths (e.g., /about) return 200
facts.source_quote: Verify: apex + www resolve to the new site over HTTPS, cert issued, http->https and www/apex canonicalization work, and https://mindmatterbh.com/about (extensionless) returns 200

facts.text: Step 6: Save exact rollback steps as a note; remind user to submit sitemap to Google Search Console after cutover
facts.source_quote: Give me the exact rollback steps as a saved note, and remind me to submit the sitemap in Google Search Console after cutover

facts.text: Known open issue: contact form backend is not functional yet; being fixed separately
facts.source_quote: Known open issue, for your awareness: the site's contact form backend is not functional yet (being fixed separately)

facts.text: Contact form backend non-functionality is accepted risk; launch decision belongs to user
facts.source_quote: If we complete DNS today, that's accepted - launch decision is mine

facts.text: Old Squarespace site must remain intact as rollback target for ~2 weeks after cutover
facts.source_quote: It must remain intact as a rollback target for ~2 weeks after cutover
